StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

BeforeHandDraw.rationale: The sim has NO before_hand_draw hook among hooks.py's 66 dispatchers, so this lands on on_player_turn_start (player.py:169) -- and that happens to be the RIGHT relative position, which is worth stating because it is the wrong one for this slot's other occupants. C# fires Hook.BeforeHandDraw at CombatManager.cs:652: after the energy reset (:644) and Hook.AfterEnergyReset (:650), before Hook.ModifyHandDraw (:654) and CardPileCmd.Draw (:673). The sim's on_player_turn_start sits at player.py:169: after the energy reset and on_energy_reset (:163-168), before modify_hand_draw (:171) and _draw (:183). Same neighbours in the same order, so the added cards are in hand before the draw count is computed on both sides. The powers whose C# hook is BeforeSideTurnStart (CombatManager.cs:458, i.e. BEFORE the energy reset) share this one sim slot and are the ones misplaced by it -- see power/plating, and py audit/tools/power_census.py slots.

guards.what: HelloWorldPower.cs:22 base.AmountOnTurnStart >= 1 (used as BOTH the guard and the card count)
guards.issue: The guard is ported as self.amount < 1 (powers.py:2811) and the count as self.amount (:2825), where C# uses base.AmountOnTurnStart for both (HelloWorldPower.cs:22 and :27). PowerModel.AmountOnTurnStart has NO sim counterpart -- grep -rn amount_on_turn_start sts2_rl/ returns nothing. C# snapshots every power's Amount into it in Creature.BeforeTurnStart (Creature.cs:673-679), called at CombatManager.cs:453 before any other turn-start hook, and its documented purpose (PowerModel.cs:199-205) is exactly 'preventing same-turn activation when applied mid-turn (e.g., via auto-play effects)'. Only three ported powers read it -- this one, HelloWorldPower and SummonNextTurnPower (unported) -- so it is a small but load-bearing field. The two numbers differ exactly when the power's Amount changed between the snapshot at CombatManager.cs:453 and BeforeHandDraw at :652 -- i.e. when a BeforeSideTurnStart, AfterTurnStart, AfterBlockCleared or AfterEnergyReset listener applied or stacked Hello World. DORMANT: the only ported applier is the Trash Heap card Hello World itself (cards/trash_heap_cards.py:186-203, applied on play during the play phase), so nothing reaches that window today. Named trigger: any auto-play or turn-start effect that plays Hello World, at which point the sim would add cards on the turn the power landed and the game would not.

guards.what: HelloWorldPower.cs:27 the draw runs on Rng.CombatCardGeneration via TakeRandom
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 6): both halves: the stream AND the algorithm. `CardFactory.GetDistinctForCombat(..., RunState.Rng.CombatCardGeneration)` (HelloWorldPower.cs:23-27) ends in `TakeRandom(count, rng)`, which is `collection.ToList().UnstableShuffle(rng).Take(count)` (IEnumerableExtensions.cs:17-20) -- a FULL Fisher-Yates over the candidates followed by the first N, i.e. len-1 draws, not N. The port's `random.sample` was a different algorithm on a different stream, so it took the wrong cards AND left the counter in the wrong place. powers.py now shuffles the candidate list on `combat_rng.card_gen` and slices.  The text it replaced read: WRONG RNG STREAM AND WRONG ALGORITHM, and the correct sim helper exists and is not used. C# is CardFactory.GetDistinctForCombat(..., base.AmountOnTurnStart, base.Owner.Player.RunState.Rng.CombatCardGeneration) (HelloWorldPower.cs:25-27 -> CardFactory.cs:119-129), whose selection is FilterForCombat(...).TakeRandom(count, rng) == UnstableShuffle(rng).Take(n) (IEnumerableExtensions.cs:17). The sim does combat._rng.sample(commons, n) (powers.py:2826), and combat._rng is the SHARED unseeded random.Random (combat.py:88) -- not the per-purpose accessor. cards.pool.get_distinct_for_combat_parity (pool.py:182-204) is an already-written, already-documented parity port of exactly this call, driven by combat.combat_rng.card_gen (combat_rng.py:20,50), and this power does not call it; seven other sites do (potions.py:435,468,1082,1120,1148, cards/infernal_blade.py:40, relics/vexing_puzzlebox.py:26). LIVE under seed parity: the identical defect is already recorded LIVE on power/aggression (report section 4 item 8), and here it is sharper because a wrong-stream/wrong-algorithm pick both names a different card AND perturbs every later draw off the shared rng. Hello World is a ported Trash Heap card (cards/trash_heap_cards.py:186-203) reachable from the ported Trash Heap event, so both halves of binding rule 6 hold. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.rationale: powers.py:2827 CardPileCmd.add_to_hand per card, which is the same destination and fires the same on_card_entered_combat path. The sim also clamps n to len(commons) (powers.py:2825) where TakeRandom's Take(n) does the clamping implicitly -- equivalent.
Neither side ticks or removes it, so it adds cards every turn for the rest of the combat. Both agree.
